control-board.context: An electronic control board used in a regulated device; use stýrispjald. Use stýrispjaldssnið for a profile describing that board. Reserve stjórnborð for a user-facing control panel, and do not use borð, bretti, or stýriborð for the circuit board.

provenance.method: Semantic correction informed by Icelandic electrical terminology research

board-profile.context: A profile describing an electronic control board. Keep it distinct from stýrispjald (the physical board), tækjasnið (the complete device profile), and borð or stjórnborð (physical-table or user-interface meanings).

provenance.method: Terminology policy confirmed by maintainer after Icelandic technical-usage research

device-profile.context: A profile describing the complete vaping device. Use tækjasnið for this device-level meaning; use stýrispjaldssnið when the profile belongs to the electronic control board. Do not use tækissnið, mod-prófíll, or mod-snið.

provenance.method: Terminology policy confirmed by maintainer after Icelandic technical-usage research

battery-cell.context: An individual rechargeable cell, distinguished from a battery pack or device-integrated battery. The shorter synonym sella is used in battery-calculator labels and help; rafhlöðufruma remains valid. University of Iceland Vísindavefurinn (2017-03-31, answer 14877) supports the cell lemma, not full sentence grammar.

provenance.method: Semantic correction informed by Icelandic battery terminology research

output-power.context: This is emitted power from the atomizer, not a user-interface output.
